evidence_items.explanation: Under matched prompting, evaluators distinguished GPT-2 from human text more accurately than GPT-3 from human text across stories, news, and recipes. This supports improved naturalness, although humanlikeness is an indirect fluency measure.

receipt.public_excerpt: These error categories decrease with in-domain training (Grover) and larger model size (GPT-3).

evidence_items.explanation: Matched GPT-2/GPT-3 comparisons find reductions in encyclopedic, commonsense, and incoherence errors. Other categories plateau or behave less consistently, and generation settings affect the results.

unresolved_gaps: These studies measure comparative output improvements, not a ledger of individually patched mistakes.
They do not directly compare GPT-2 with the January 30, 2023 ChatGPT update.
